meaning: MIRV band vertical LOWER limit (hex 80 = 128). ICPOSI re-arms MIRVIX only while a live ICBM's height is within [MIRVLO,MIRVHI]. EQU.

meaning: MIRV band vertical UPPER limit (hex A0 = 160). Upper bound of the MIRV-eligible height band, inclusive. EQU.

meaning: Max child ICBMs from one MIRV split = 3. MIRVER caps the POTENT shot budget at 2 (LDA I,2 when POTENT>=2), and the launch loop fires operand+1 = 3 shots (the STA POTENT line's own comment: 'NO MORE THAN 3 SHOTS FROM A MIRV', W3MAIN.MAC:2717). Derived as the LDA I,2 immediate + 1, mirroring CITYBON's inclusive-loop derivation.

MIRV suppression threshold = 12 (decimal) live explosions. UPICBM: LDY EXPLCT / CPY I,12. / IFCS -> STA MIRVIX (-1) 'NO MIRVS IF TOO MANY EXPLOSIONS' (W3MAIN.MAC:1531-1535). Value is the decimal immediate 12. (trailing dot = decimal under .RADIX 16).
